cases.native: तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात्
cases.ours: tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt
cases.golden: tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt

cases.native: कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि
cases.ours: karmaṇyevādhikāraste mā phaleṣu kadācana mā karmaphalaheturbhūrmā te saṅgo'stvakarmaṇi
cases.golden: karmaṇyevādhikāraste mā phaleṣu kadācana mā karmaphalaheturbhūrmā te saṅgo'stvakarmaṇi

cases.native: नासतो विद्यते भावो नाभावो विद्यते सतः
cases.ours: nāsato vidyate bhāvo nābhāvo vidyate sataḥ
cases.golden: nāsato vidyate bhāvo nābhāvo vidyate sataḥ

cases.native: यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति
cases.ours: yo māṃ paśyati sarvatra sarvaṃ ca mayi paśyati
cases.golden: yo māṃ paśyati sarvatra sarvaṃ ca mayi paśyati

cases.native: बुद्धं शरणं गच्छामि धम्मं शरणं गच्छामि संघं शरणं गच्छामि
cases.ours: buddhaṃ śaraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammaṃ śaraṇaṃ gacchāmi saṃghaṃ śaraṇaṃ gacchāmi
cases.golden: buddhaṃ śaraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammaṃ śaraṇaṃ gacchāmi saṃghaṃ śaraṇaṃ gacchāmi
